statement: Matassa is the Roussillon estate founded by Tom Lubbe in 2003. CARTA activates only the minimum stable producer/person identity needed to support the documented Lampyres professional bridge; this is not a Matassa enrichment dossier.

François-Xavier Dauré worked for Tom Lubbe at Matassa across five vintages, from the 2015 vintage through the 2019 vintage, in vineyard and cellar work while building Domaine Lampyres in parallel; Lampyres' first vintage was 2016.
scope_notes: The date range represents the sourced vintage span, not exact employment start/end dates. Importer descriptions of Dauré as Lubbe's 'right hand' are not promoted to machine fact, and MENTORED_BY is deliberately not asserted.
